title: Enforcement Decree of the Korea Transportation Safety Authority Act

ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE KOREA TRANSPORTATION SAFETY AUTHORITY ACT

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Korea Transportation Safety Authority Act and matters necessary for its enforcement. <Amended on February 8, 2019>

Article 2 (Registration of Establishment)
(1) Pursuant to Article 3 of the Korea Transportation Safety Authority Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"), the Korea Transportation Safety Authority (hereinafter referred to as the "Authority") shall register its establishment at the location of its principal office within three weeks from the date on which its articles of incorporation are authorized. <Amended on February 8, 2019>
(2) The matters to be registered under paragraph (1) shall be as follows:
1. Purpose;
2. Name;
3. Locations of the principal office and branch offices;
4. Names and addresses of executive officers;
5. Method of public announcement.

Article 3 Deleted. <April 6, 2009>

Article 4 (Registration of Establishment of Branch Offices)
Where the Authority establishes a branch office, it shall register the name, location, and date of establishment of the branch office at the location of its principal office within three weeks after establishment.

Article 5 (Registration of Relocation)
(1) Where the Authority relocates its principal office, it shall register the new location and the date of relocation at either the former or the new location within three weeks after relocation.
(2) Where the Authority relocates a branch office, it shall register the new location and the date of relocation at the location of its principal office within three weeks after relocation.

Article 6 (Registration of Changes)
Where any matter registered under the subparagraphs of Article 2 (2) or under Article 4 changes (excluding cases constituting registration of relocation under Article 5), the Authority shall register the changes at the location of its principal office within three weeks after the change.

Article 7 (Documents for Applications for Registration)
An application for each registration under Article 2 and Articles 4 through 6 shall be accompanied by the documents specified in the following categories:
1. Registration of establishment under Article 2: The relevant articles of incorporation;
2. Registration of establishment of a branch office under Article 4: Documents proving the establishment of the branch office;
3. Registration of relocation under Article 5: Documents proving the relocation of the principal office or branch office;
4. Registration of changes under Article 6: Documents proving the changes.

Article 8 (Calculation of Registration Periods)
For matters to be registered under this Decree that require authorization or approval from the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the registration period shall be calculated from the date on which the written authorization or approval is received. <Amended on March 23, 2013>

Article 13 (Payment of Government Contributions)
(1) Where the Government intends to pay contributions under subparagraph 1 of Article 13 of the Act to the Authority, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall reflect such contributions in the budget and pay them. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(2) To receive a contribution under paragraph (1), the Authority shall submit an application for payment to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, accompanied by a business plan and a budget execution plan. <Amended on March 23, 2013>

Article 13-2 (Contributions from Persons Other than the Government)
(1) The methods of making contributions by persons other than the Government under subparagraph 1 of Article 13 of the Act and related matters may be determined through consultation between the person intending to make a contribution and the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(2) The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport may request the heads of relevant ministries to cooperate in securing contributions from persons other than the Government under paragraph (1). <Amended on March 23, 2013>

Article 13-3 (Equity Investments and Contributions)
(1) Where the Authority intends to make an equity investment or contribution pursuant to Article 13-2 of the Act, it shall submit an application for approval containing the following matters to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport: <Amended on March 23, 2013>
1. The necessity of the equity investment or contribution;
2. The types and value of the property to be invested or contributed;
3. An outline of the project in which the equity investment or contribution is to be made;
4. Other matters necessary for the equity investment or contribution.
(2) Where government budgetary support is required for an equity investment or contribution under paragraph (1), the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall consult in advance with the Minister of Planning and Budget. <Amended on March 23, 2013; December 30, 2025>

Article 13-4 (Government Subsidies and Loans)
To receive a subsidy or a loan from fiscal funds necessary for carrying out its business pursuant to Article 16-3 of the Act, the Authority shall submit an application for the subsidy or loan to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, accompanied by a business plan and a budget execution plan. <Amended on March 23, 2013>

Article 21 (Borrowing of Funds)
(1) Where the Authority intends to borrow funds or import goods from a foreign country pursuant to Article 16-2 of the Act, it shall submit an application for approval containing the following matters to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport: <Amended on March 23, 2013>
1. The reasons for borrowing and the amount to be borrowed (or, where goods are to be imported, the type, quantity, and price of the goods);
2. The institution from which the funds are to be borrowed or the goods are to be imported;
3. The terms of the proposed borrowing or importation;
4. The method and deadline for repayment of the borrowed funds or the goods to be imported;
5. Other matters necessary for the borrowing of funds or importation of goods and their repayment.
(2) Where the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport intends to approve the borrowing of funds or importation of goods from a foreign country under paragraph (1), the Minister shall consult in advance with the Minister of Finance and Economy. <Amended on March 23, 2013; December 30, 2025>

Article 22 (Submission of Business Plans)
(1) Pursuant to Article 24 of the Act, the Authority shall submit its business plan and proposed budget for the following year to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport by November 30 of each year and obtain approval. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(2) When submitting the business plan and proposed budget under paragraph (1), the Authority shall attach the documents necessary to clarify their contents.
(3) Where the Authority intends to amend a business plan or budget approved under paragraph (1), it shall submit documents stating the reasons for and details of the amendments to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and obtain approval. <Amended on March 23, 2013>

Article 23 Deleted. <July 6, 1995>

Article 24

Article 25 (Treatment of Surplus)
Where the settlement of accounts for a business year results in a surplus, the Authority shall apply the surplus to offset losses carried forward and use the remainder as funds for the Authority's business in the following year.

Article 26 (Disposal of Important Property)
(1) The term "important property prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 28, subparagraph 4 of the Act means property with an estimated price of at least 1 billion won. In such cases, the estimated price shall be the arithmetic mean of the prices investigated and calculated by at least two certified appraisers registered pursuant to Article 17(1) of the Act on Appraisal and Certified Appraisers. <Amended on August 31, 2016>
(2) Prior approval from the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall be obtained to transfer, acquire, lend, or exchange important property under paragraph (1), or to provide such property as security; provided that this shall not apply to matters included in a business plan and budget approved by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport pursuant to Article 22. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
